answer: The vault receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a ocean seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 13 aliases trips the duplicate check at the juniper gate. Bonded capital sits idle for 11 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
